Removed the noise overlay and the `'no-repeat'` property.

**What removing 'no-repeat' does:**
- With `backgroundSize: '100% 100%'`, the image is stretched to fill the container, so removing `'no-repeat'` has no visible effect here.
- If the image were smaller than the container and not stretched, removing `'no-repeat'` would make it tile/repeat to fill the space.

Since the background is set to `100% 100%`, the image already covers the entire modal, so removing `'no-repeat'` won't change the appearance. The modal now shows the Portfolio background image without the noise overlay.
